rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN PELVIS CTA / Other Vascular Abnormalities of the Abdomen and Pelvis
rules.source_quote: Evaluation of known or suspected mesenteric ischemia/ischemic colitis

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion or known acute or chronic mesenteric ischemia or ischemic colitis

required_documentation: Urgent clinical notes detailing postprandial pain, bloody stools, or acute severe abdominal pain out of proportion to exam

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN PELVIS CTA / Other Vascular Abnormalities
rules.source_quote: Suspected pelvic congestive syndrome (including May-Thurner and nutcracker syndromes) when ultrasound is indeterminant

criteria.description: Suspected pelvic congestion syndrome, May-Thurner, or nutcracker syndrome
Initial pelvic or vascular ultrasound was indeterminate

required_documentation: Pelvic or vascular duplex ultrasound report demonstrating indeterminate or incomplete evaluation of venous compression
rules.review_notes: Diagnostic prerequisite ultrasound requirement for pelvic venous compression syndromes.
